newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Gas seen raising Australia power market share.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Gas seen raising Australia power market share.

text.p: Fast growth by natural gas to a predicted 20 percent share of Australia's power market by 2000 showed a strong need for infrastructure development, an industry official told an electricity supply conference on Thursday.

Greg Harvey, chairman of the Australian Gas Association and chief executive of the Victorian Gas and Fuel Corp, told the Electricity Supply Association of Australia annual conference that over the past five years natural gas had boosted its share of the primary energy market to 18.3 percent from 16.0.
He said the gas industry was expected to sustain an average annual growth rate of 3.5 percent a year until year 2010, against overall growth by electricity of 2.0 percent a year.
Over the past year Australia's natural gas sales had increased by eight percent to 701 petajoules for sales growth of 30 percent over the last five years, he said.
"All this points to a continuing strong need for gas infrastructure and development," Harvey said.

Natural gas had yet to achieve the geographic market penetration of electricity and liquid petroleum products, he said. But traditional barriers between gas and electricity were crumbling fast with industry reform and restructuring, he said.
This was expected to lead to the creation of a national energy market that would add considerably to consumer choice and responsibility, Harvey said.
